title: 第5章 暗影侵袭第6章 武器和防具
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
对于苏墨来说，目前最重要的就是重新修炼，但是丧尸还没解封，各种传承也还在封锁。
即便空气中有股神秘能量默默的滋养，但达不到修炼的要求，主动和被动的区别还是很大的。
在发现晶珠之前，苏墨已经想好前期靠什么职业过渡了，但之后又改变了想法，如果他猜的没错的话，这颗晶珠必定有着传承或者功法。
接受传承或功法后就可以得到相应的职业，个人信息也会发生改变，后续要换传承或功法的话，不仅要消耗资源，还要浪费时间。
不过这个世界最不缺的就是能人，在永恒蓝星上就有一部分人，自行领悟，开创职业，还能自行开发相应的能力。
前世，苏墨也想过法武融合，最后就成了现在这样了。
噼啪燃烧的火焰声，将苏墨的思绪拉回了现实。
苏墨对能增加燃烧时长的东西都了如指掌，一块木头可以增添1.5小时，草和树枝可以增添10分钟…，清点一下今天的收获：
[草×24，树枝×25，花瓣×29，木头×20，石头×21，燧石×20，金块×10，浆果×9，胡萝卜×8]
起身舒展一下酸痛的肌肉，干了一天的活，即便有股游离的能量滋养肉身，但大量的劳动会让身心俱疲。
营火燃烧的光，阻止了暗影的侵袭，给人一种温暖的感觉，周围方圆100米之外，全是一片漆黑，身处黑暗之中，耳边会有呓语声，而且会感觉到一种阴冷黏腻之感。
夜晚仿佛暗夜的主场，营火的光被限制在100米以内，火苗随着风摇摆，却不会被吹灭。
赵敢当正在烤着浆果，按照他的说法，烤熟的浆果味道更好，而且还增加了更多的饱食度。
眼神不时撇向苏墨，苏墨的眼神深邃，舞动的营火在他的眼里显得很静默。
“苏兄弟，俺烤好了浆果，你要尝尝吗，味道真的比不烤的好吃。”
苏墨笑着接受，彼此之间的信任感不是一蹴而就，赵敢当这个憨货，倒也是一个好人，相处起来很愉快没有一种矫揉造作的感觉。
前世苏墨经常与一些心思深沉的老阴币打交道，那种被算计的死死的感觉可不好受，此刻苏墨的心态也发生了变化。
烤熟浆果的味道更酸甜可口，连一点涩味都没有了，苏墨很少吃烤熟的浆果，饱食度只多了不到三点，还很容易烤焦。
查看个人信息——
姓名：苏墨（普通）

职业：无
生命值：150150
精神值：120150（5点小时↓）
饱食度：150150
暗影能量的活跃导致精神值以每小时5点的速度下降着，这个速度已经有大幅度削减了，单独一人过夜的话，就是每小时8点，两个人降低至5点，十个人降低至3点，一百人降低至1点，之后不管再多人都不会有所降低。
拍打疏通四肢的乳酸，之后便是休息恢复体力的时间。
苏墨和赵敢当两个人一商量就决定轮流守夜，苏墨前半夜，赵敢当后半夜，看面板右上角的信息知道还有6小时进入白天，其实就算不睡觉也不会有多大关系，这种游离能量不止对肉身有效，而是全方位的恢复。
content_en:
For Su Mo, the most important thing at the moment is to practice again, but the zombies have not yet been unblocked, and various inheritances are still blocked.
Even if there is a mysterious energy in the air that is silently nourishing, but it cannot meet the requirements of cultivation, the difference between active and passive is still very big.
Before discovering the crystal bead, Su Mo had already thought about what kind of career transition he would rely on in the early stage, but then he changed his mind. If his guess was correct, this crystal bead must have a legacy or a skill.
After accepting the inheritance or skills, you can get the corresponding profession, and your personal information will also change. If you want to change the inheritance or skills later, it will not only consume resources, but also waste time.
However, what this world is most indispensable for is capable people. There are some people on the Eternal Blue Star who can understand and create careers on their own, and can also develop corresponding abilities on their own.
In his previous life, Su Mo also thought about the fusion of magic and martial arts, and it ended up like this.
The sound of crackling flames brought Su Mo's thoughts back to reality.
Su Mo knows everything that can increase the burning time. A piece of wood can increase the burning time by 1.5 hours, grass and branches can increase the burning time by 10 minutes... Let’s take a look at today’s harvest:
[Grass × 24, branches × 25, petals × 29, wood × 20, stone × 21, flint × 20, gold nuggets × 10, berries × 9, carrots × 8]
Get up and stretch your sore muscles. After a day's work, even if there is a free energy nourishing the body, the large amount of labor will make the body and mind exhausted.
The burning light of the campfire prevents the invasion of shadows and gives people a warm feeling. There is total darkness within a radius of 100 meters. When you are in the darkness, you will hear murmurs in your ears, and you will feel a cold and sticky feeling.
The night is like a dark home. The light of the campfire is limited to within 100 meters. The flames sway with the wind but will not be blown out.
Zhao Gandang is roasting berries. According to him, roasted berries taste better and increase satiety.
His eyes glanced at Su Mo from time to time. Su Mo's eyes were deep, and the dancing campfire looked very silent in his eyes.
"Brother Su, I have roasted the berries. Do you want to try them? They taste really better than those without roasting."
Su Mo smiled and accepted. The trust between each other was not established overnight. Although Zhao dared to be this idiot, he was actually a good person. It was pleasant to get along with him without any pretentious feeling.
In his previous life, Su Mo often dealt with some deep-minded old Yin coins. The feeling of being plotted against him was not pleasant. At this moment, Su Mo's mentality also changed.
The taste of roasted berries is more sour and sweet, and there is no astringency at all. Su Mo rarely eats roasted berries, and the satiety level is only less than three points higher, and they are easily burnt.
View personal information——
Name: Su Mo (normal)
Occupation: None
HP: 150150
Mental value: 120150 (5 o'clock hours↓)
Fullness: 150150
The activity of shadow energy causes the mental value to decrease at a rate of 5 points per hour. This rate has been greatly reduced. If a person spends the night alone, it is 8 points per hour. It drops to 5 points for two people, to 3 points for ten people, and to 1 point for a hundred people. After that, it will not decrease no matter how many people there are.
Paid to clear the lactic acid in the limbs, and then it is time to rest and regain strength.
Su Mo and Zhao Gandang decided to take turns to watch the night after discussing it. Su Mo would stay in the first half of the night, and Zhao Gan would stay in the second half of the night. Looking at the information in the upper right corner of the panel, they knew that there were still 6 hours until daytime. In fact, it wouldn't matter much even if they didn't sleep. This kind of free energy was not only effective for the physical body, but also for all-round recovery.
